name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY)
benefit_summary: ₹50,000 per hectare over 3 years for farmers adopting organic farming in a cluster (minimum 50 farmers / 50 acres per cluster), covering certification, inputs, and processing
required_documents: Cluster group registration (formed with neighboring farmers)
notes: VERIFY against your own pkvy_organic_farming.txt — this scheme is cluster-based, so an individual farmer generally cannot apply alone; confirm current cluster formation process in your district.
